description: Ayuntamiento de Cáceres: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Cáceres. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Cáceres. The listing groups 14 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Puntos de recarga; Potencial Solar Fotovoltaico Cáceres Enero; Potencial Solar Fotovoltaico Cáceres Mayo; Potencial Solar Fotovoltaico Cáceres Julio. Formats seen: WMS, HTML, GEO%2BJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by), as linked on the portal listing (https://opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
